content.text: I'll start by looking at the project layout and the module in question.
I have what I need. The two fixes go in `_parse_cyclonedx` (also walk `metadata.component.components`, nested) and `parse_sbom` (refuse a document carrying both format markers before picking one).

I updated `core/sbom.py` so `_parse_cyclonedx` also flattens `metadata.component.components` (at any depth, product itself still excluded), and `parse_sbom` now raises a `FormatError` stating the document carries both formats when `bomFormat` and `spdxVersion` are both present, before any format-specific parsing.
